Collections of relatable data

Real-world data, ready to resolve

Collections of relatable data (CORD) are real-world data sets mapped for SENZING® entity resolution. Download one, load it and see how records from different sources come together.

Browse the catalogCORDs on senzing.com

What CORDs are

Data that relates

Each CORD is a JSON Lines file of person and organization records from one source, such as a sanctions list or a company register, in one locale, such as London or Las Vegas. CORDs from the same locale describe some of the same people, organizations and addresses, so loading two or more shows how the Senzing SDK matches and relates records across sources.

Read more on the CORD page at senzing.com.

Download

Get a CORD with curl

Every CORD is a file on a GitHub Release. This downloads ofac-london.jsonl and checks its SHA-256:

curl -fsSLO https://github.com/docktermj/senzing-cord-development-test/releases/download/0.1.1/ofac-london.jsonl
echo "2299bcaf6b9111fed771b3c54a56685f5239f75c57c47d322020f742c21eb40b  ofac-london.jsonl" | sha256sum -c

The CORD catalog lists all 9 CORDs by locale, with their sources, record counts, features, samples and download commands.

CORD files are published as GitHub Releases of docktermj/senzing-cord-development-test and listed in manifest.json.
